about_the_game:
This Pack includes:

  • F-20A Tigershark (Rank 8 USA);

  • Premium account for 20 days;

  • 2500 Golden Eagles.

The F-20A Tigershark is an agile multi-role fighter developed by Northrop in the late 1970s, designed to fulfill a wide range of operational duties.

The Tigershark is a fast and agile fighter, equipped with two 20 mm M39A3 cannons, chaff and flares, along with AIM-7F radar missiles or up to six AIM-9L sidewinders! For ground targets, it can carry multiple types of bombs, a large amount of Mighty Mouse rockets, you can even equip four AGM-65B Mavericks and a 30 mm GAU/13A cannon!

The F-20A excels as both a fast, highly agile fighter and a precise ground attacker, its powerful engine and advanced avionics allow you to combat any threat effectively.

Note!

  • Refund is not provided if you purchase 2 different packs which include the same vehicle or you already have the vehicle from this pack!

  • Available for Linux, Windows and Mac only. You can't activate this item for the PSN or Xbox Live account.
